==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} Where did I agree to meet Hualin? Was it here... or over there?
:{{DIcon}} Why aren't I there yet?
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Zongye:''' Zhiyuan, stop sulking! I won't stop you. I'm just worried about you.
:{{DIcon}} I'm not Zhiyuan.
:{{DIcon}} Sir, you're mistaking me for someone else.
:'''Zongye:''' You... You're not Zhiyuan?... Oh, right. You're not...
:'''Zongye:''' I'm getting old and confused. I'm sorry, I'm sorry...
:'''Zongye:''' hy don't you come home, Zhiyuan...
----
;(After completing [[Echoing Marche]])
:'''Zongye:''' Oh, you're... You're that...
:{{DIcon}} I'm {{Rover}}.
:'''Zongye:''' Right, right. I remember now. It was all thanks to you.
:'''Zongye:''' [[Zhiyuan]] told me about you. I must have influenced that kid to want to join the army.
:'''Zongye:''' But in any case, thanks to you and that little girl, he got a good dose of reality.
:{{DIcon}} You're too kind.
:'''Zongye:''' Now, I won't stop him. I'm actually glad he's found something he wants to do.
:'''Zongye:''' [[Hualin]] and I will give him lessons every now and then.
:'''Zongye:''' Even if he can't join Midnight Rangers, at least he'll be able to protect himself.
{{Dialogue End}}
